the-first-lantern.title: The First Lantern
the-first-lantern.coverAlt: A lantern burning on a stone harbour wall at dusk
the-first-lantern.summary: When the harbour light goes out on the coldest night of the year, Nell has to climb the tower alone.

the-last-train-home.title: The Last Train Home
the-last-train-home.coverAlt: A lantern burning on a stone harbour wall at dusk
the-last-train-home.summary: The last train of the night stops at a station that is not on the map, and only one passenger gets off.

the-tin-whistle.title: The Tin Whistle
the-tin-whistle.coverAlt: A dented tin whistle on a kitchen windowsill in the morning light
the-tin-whistle.summary: A whistle found in a drawer plays for everyone, but only Grandmother seems to hear what it is really saying.

what-the-fog-brought-in.title: What the Fog Brought In
what-the-fog-brought-in.coverAlt: A dented tin whistle on a kitchen windowsill in the morning light
what-the-fog-brought-in.summary: A lighthouse keeper counts the ships that answer the horn, and this winter one of them answers twice.

the-fisherman-and-his-wife.title: The Fisherman and His Wife
the-fisherman-and-his-wife.coverAlt: A small boat on a grey sea under a low sky
the-fisherman-and-his-wife.summary: A poor fisherman catches a talking flounder, and his wife discovers that wanting more has no end.

the-monkeys-paw.title: The Monkey's Paw
the-monkeys-paw.coverAlt: A lantern burning on a stone harbour wall at dusk
the-monkeys-paw.summary: A mummified paw grants three wishes to whoever holds it, and takes payment in the only currency it deals in.
